title: ComplexMultiTenantDocumentExport
description: A multi-tenant document service where members and admins search, retrieve, batch-select, and export documents that belong to their tenant while preserving document-level authorization.
generation_notes: Roles are member and admin, and every request derives tenant identity from the authenticated principal.
Enforce tenant and object authorization on search, get, batch, and export operations.
Unauthorized access must return 403 or 404 and must not expose another tenant's document contents or metadata.
Limit batches to 100 documents, rejecting larger selections before export work begins.
Use SQL parameters only for searches, retrievals, batch selection, and export queries.
